data.description: 市立图书馆过道上，洛琪希穿藏蓝马甲、象牙白长袖棉衬衫和蓝灰直筒裤，两只前臂托住一摞厚课本，双手分别撑住底书两侧，认真看向前面的阅读桌。书堆没有挡住她的眼睛，近处书页断面与一枚露出的页签清楚可见；低书车停在过道边，两侧书架通向长阅读桌，尽头高窗旁还有直立的资料架。右侧高窗斜光照到蓝发辫、书页上缘与马甲肩部，层层书缝留下暗影，地板亮带沿过道延伸——「哇哇……现代的印刷书本比想象中还要重！那边的同学，能麻烦你帮我分担几本吗？」
data.lighting: slanting high-window light from the right on braids and book edges; layered shade between volumes
data.location: 市立图书馆阅读过道，书车与两侧书架通向高窗下的阅读桌
data.promptProse: Library textbooks rest across Roxy Migurdia's two forearms, with each hand supporting one side of the bottom volume as she takes careful steps toward a reading table. The stack stops below her eyes, keeping her earnest expression clear between blue braids. A tailored navy vest and ivory cotton blouse accompany slate-blue trousers. Uneven page edges and one projecting tab occupy the near side of the books. A low library cart is parked outside her route; shelves on either side lead toward long tables and a document rack beside the high windows. Frame this support and the aisle at eye level in a medium view. Slanting light from the right window catches braid edges, the upper pages and vest shoulder. Dark gaps separate the volumes, while a pale strip of light on the floor follows the unobstructed passage.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 现代图书馆
